::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Credit
This embeds the **Commute Explorer** app created by **Stefan Schliebs**, a winner
of the [3rd Annual Posit (RStudio) Shiny Contest](https://posit.co/blog/winners-of-the-3rd-annual-shiny-contest#commute-explorer).
It explores commuting patterns across New Zealand using 2018 Census data.
Live app: [nz-stefan.shinyapps.io/commute-explorer-2](https://nz-stefan.shinyapps.io/commute-explorer-2/)
· [source code](https://github.com/nz-stefan/commute-explorer-2).
All credit for the app goes to the author.
:::

The app below is served live from the author's shinyapps.io deployment and
embedded here. If it does not load, open it directly:
[Commute Explorer ↗](https://nz-stefan.shinyapps.io/commute-explorer-2/){target="_blank"}.

```{=html}
<div style="position: relative; width: 100%; height: 85vh; min-height: 640px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;">
  <iframe
    src="https://nz-stefan.shinyapps.io/commute-explorer-2/"
    title="Commute Explorer by Stefan Schliebs"
    loading="lazy"
    allowfullscreen
    style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;">
  </iframe>
</div>
```
